_comment: Device Setup card of the PicoQuant backend, drawn by emtk over setup_forms.PicoQuantSetupForm. Replaces the hand-drawn card and, before it, the Qt PicoQuantSetupDialog.

sections.description: What this card can set and what the firmware owns.

sections.text: PicoQuant devices are configured by snAPI, firmware, and INI files. This card does not claim a physical connection.
sections.description: What this card can and cannot set.
Settings the firmware and INI files own (read only).

sections.label: Maximum photons
sections.description: Photons after which the acquisition stops, 1,000 to 10,000,000. Press Enter or click elsewhere to commit; Apply makes it the acquisition's stop limit.
Device status and the card's actions.
What the last action did, or why it did not.
Query the device and apply the stop limit.

buttons.label: Refresh status
buttons.description: Query the initialized PicoQuant API for connected devices; an unavailable API does not imply a connection.

buttons.label: Apply
buttons.description: Use the validated maximum-photon count as the acquisition stop limit; firmware settings remain unchanged.

buttons.label: OK / close
buttons.description: Close device setup. Only settings already committed with Apply affect the device or acquisition.

buttons.label: Cancel
buttons.description: Close this card without applying pending device-setting edits; earlier Apply operations remain in effect.
